general.text: OligInvest is for analysis and learning. It does not provide investment advice or make investment recommendations. You make investment decisions independently and at your own risk.

analysis.text: These are scenarios calculated from historical data and the assumptions adopted, not a forecast. Actual outcomes may fall outside the displayed range. Past performance does not guarantee future results.

optimization.text: The weights are the output of a mathematical model sensitive to assumptions and estimation errors. They are not a recommendation to change your portfolio.

rebalance.text: The list shows the transactions needed to reach the target allocation you set. It is not a recommendation to execute them; costs and tax are estimates.

backtest.text: A backtest shows how a rule would have performed in the past under the assumed costs and simplifications. It does not predict the future. The more variants tested, the greater the risk that a good result is due to chance.

screener.text: The list contains instruments matching your criteria. It is neither a ranking nor an encouragement to purchase.

alerts.text: An alert reports that a condition you set has been met. It is not a signal to enter a transaction.

tax_view.text: The tax view is informational and may differ from PIT-8C and your tax return. It is not tax advice.

data_delay.text: Quotes are delayed (usually by about 15 minutes) or come from the session close. The data source and time are shown with each value.

export.text: Data exported from OligInvest is for personal use; it includes data covered by provider licences — do not publish it. Analyses are not recommendations or advice.

education.text: Educational materials are general and do not take your circumstances into account.

demo.text: Demo mode: a fictional portfolio using historical data. Transactions do not affect your data.
